scope.object: RL policy parameters and a growing reference graph of successful states/actions used for credit assignment.
scope.feedback: Task success, graph membership and progress labels shape policy-gradient advantage.
scope.retention: Learned weights and added reference trajectories persist across training; fixed graph union, purity and shaping algorithms do not themselves evolve.
scope.weights: Qwen policies are optimized with AdamW through GRPO/DAPO/GiGPO/PPO variants.
scope.limit: Changing reference content alongside model weights is not evidence that external Harness instructions, management machinery or orchestration are iteratively rewritten.

version_changes: Progress-advancement formula gains an explicit Rea_t factor, aligning it with the stated requirement that progress implies a reasonable transition.
The efficiency metric is corrected from environment interaction steps to RL training steps; new wall-clock analysis is separate and averages methods under seed 1.

Table 1 changes PPO results materially: ALFWorld overall 1.5B 36.5 to 73.2, 7B 60.9 to 83.6; WebShop SR 1.5B 28.1 to 55.2, 7B 44.3 to 66.7. SFT/direct-prompt means and uncertainty conventions also change.
Table 2 adds progress-reward and suffix-length ablations and revises WebShop ProAS-minus scores from TS83.6/SR63.3 to TS86.0/SR63.8; bold/star annotations change.
v2 spells out step-wise sparse reward broadcast and the PR reward term; PPO uses 128 tasks with one rollout each versus 16 tasks with 8 rollouts for critic-free methods.
Masking comparator description changes from masking non-advancing actions to masking reasonable actions on negative trajectories; causal cascading wording is softened to downstream deviation.
limits: Main results select the highest-validation-SR checkpoint from evaluations every ten training steps; no independent final test is established by this description.
Universal-improvement rhetoric exceeds the table: 7B GiGPO WebShop SR 70.3 becomes 70.1 with ProAS.
Dynamic ARG is reference-data accumulation under a fixed update rule. Do not upgrade to Harness coevolution solely from graph changes.
New wall-clock figure reports one seed averaged over algorithms, not full matched training-cost replication.
Compared methods, equation change, key tables and changed experiment configuration were read; not all underlying runs, statistical estimates or appendix values were reproduced.
numeric_checks: New Table 1 PPO and SFT/direct rows independently compared between v1 and v2; both PPO model-size rows change substantially.
Main Table 1 GiGPO+ProAS ALFWorld 91.9/94.3 and WebShop maxima66.7/70.8 remain, while some baselines and uncertainty entries change.
New Table 2 PR and suffix rows and modified ProAS-minus WebShop cells were read; changes must not be silently transplanted into v1 summaries.
